table.field_names: neuPrint ConnectsTo.weight (also weightHP, weightAxonAxon, weightAxonDendrite, weightDendriteDendrite, weightDendriteAxon); bulk file connectome-weights-male-cns-v1.0-minconf-0.5.feather; neuprint-python fetch_adjacencies -> columns bodyId_pre, bodyId_post, weight, roi
table.unit: count of detected synapses (dimensionless integer) per directed ordered pair, optionally per ROI
table.caveat: ANATOMICAL COUNT, not measured conductance. No quantal size, no release probability, no receptor density, no short-term plasticity. The map count -> conductance is UNVERIFIED for this species/preparation. The file name encodes minconf-0.5, an ML synapse-detection confidence threshold that itself sets every weight; changing it changes W-bar.

table.field_names: gs://flyem-male-cns/v1.0/segmentation/skeletons-malecns/skeletons-swc/ (8 nm units); .../skeletons-precomputed/ (1 nm units); mirrored variants; gs://flyem-male-cns/v1.0/segmentation/skeletons-unisex-template/ (JRC2018 template, 1 um units). neuprint-python fetch_skeleton -> columns rowId, x, y, z, radius, link, structure; helper skeleton_segments() returns per-segment length, average radius, segment volume
table.unit: SWC coordinates in 8 nm voxel units (x8 for nm); template-space skeletons in 1 um units
table.status: CONFIRMED available; ell itself is DERIVED, not a shipped field
table.caveat: No per-neuron cable-length column appears among the documented downloads (body-stats-*.feather is documented as 'synapse counts for all segments', not cable length). ell must be integrated from the skeleton. Skeletons are documented as 'low resolution' with distant nodes; upsample_skeleton() exists for exactly this, so ell carries a discretization bias that must be quantified before use. Also ell is measured in FIXED, EM-prepared tissue; fixation/embedding shrinkage imposes a systematic multiplicative bias on ell whose magnitude for this protocol is UNVERIFIED.

table.target_variable: axon caliber (needed for any v(d) scaling)
table.unit: same voxel units as coordinates (8 nm)
table.caveat: Radius from EM segmentation is a fitted inscribed radius of the segmented profile, not a measured axon diameter; for sub-100 nm neurites it approaches the voxel scale (8 nm) and is quantization-limited.

table.provided_as: ConnectsTo is a directed relationship; syn-partners table pairs pre/post bodyIds; syn-points table gives polarity and ROI
body-neurotransmitters-male-cns-v1.0.feather (42 MB, aggregate per body); tbar-neurotransmitters-male-cns-v1.0.feather (2.7 GB, per presynapse)
table.status: CONFIRMED available, but the VALUE is a machine-learning PREDICTION, not a measurement
table.caveat: Sign is inferred from EM texture by a classifier with a per-prediction probability. Further, in Drosophila glutamate is frequently INHIBITORY via GluCl-alpha, so even a correct transmitter label does not determine sign. A forward model using these as signed weights is using a prediction and must carry it as an assumption, not a measured knob.

table.note: Shiu et al. 2024 (whole-brain fly leaky integrate-and-fire model) uses a FIXED 1.8 ms synaptic delay and a 2.2 ms refractory period for every synapse. That is a modelling assumption, not a per-edge measurement, and being uniform it carries zero per-edge information. Search-level confirmation only; the primary text was not fetched. Status: ASSUMPTION_IN_LITERATURE.
The third channel of spec.md P3 gets nothing from a connectome. Any P3 certificate run on a connectome-parameterized forward model still supplies A by author fiat.

2_conduction_velocity_conversion.question: can tau = ell/v be computed with a species-appropriate, literature-confirmed v?
2_conduction_velocity_conversion.verdict: NO for the general case. Exactly one Drosophila CNS neuron has a primary measured conduction velocity, and it is the single largest-caliber axon in the animal. Transporting it to typical central neurites violates ladder §1.1 (scope binding to cell type).

confirmed_rows.cell_type: Giant Fiber (GF) interneuron, an IDENTIFIED single descending interneuron
confirmed_rows.preparation: in vivo, intact fly, 24 C; direct electrical stimulation of GF, recording from flight muscle; latency over ~0.6 mm brain-to-VNC axon
confirmed_rows.source: Kadas D, Duch C, Consoulas C (2019) eNeuro 6(4):ENEURO.0181-19.2019, DOI 10.1523/ENEURO.0181-19.2019
Kadas et al. 2019 eNeuro, same DOI
confirmed_rows.note: +80% increase over the first adult day; GF outer diameter ~7 um and did NOT change significantly between timepoints (p > 0.6). The velocity change is channel-mediated, not caliber-mediated.

unverified_rows.quantity: v for a typical Drosophila central neurite (caliber ~0.1-1 um)
unverified_rows.why: No primary measurement located in this pass. Gouwens NW & Wilson RI (2009) J Neurosci 29(19):6239-6249, the standard compartmental study of Drosophila antennal lobe projection neurons, reports NO conduction velocity in m/s or mm/ms and no axon diameter; it reports fitted passive parameters only (Ri ~ 150-200 Ohm cm; Rm values per cell). Verified by direct fetch of https://www.jneurosci.org/content/29/19/6239 .
unverified_rows.consequence: The GF value ~2 m/s is an UPPER BOUND set by the fly's thickest axon (7 um, functionally the fly analogue of a Mauthner cell). Extrapolating by an unmyelinated sqrt(diameter) scaling to a 0.3 um neurite would give O(0.4 m/s), but that is an INFERENCE, not a measurement, and is recorded here as UNVERIFIED.

unverified_rows.quantity: EM fixation shrinkage correction factor for ell in this protocol
claim surfaced by search synthesis that a '3x3 compartment-indexed delay matrix reduces average error from 0.446 ms to 0.045 ms'
unverified_rows.why: Returned only as a search-engine synthesis attributed to an eLife article that plausibly does not contain it. NOT USED. Do not cite.

what_IS_determined.statement: Because ell is measured and v is a single unknown scalar, the connectome DOES determine the RELATIVE delay structure tau_i/tau_j = ell_i/ell_j (under a common-v assumption), leaving the ABSOLUTE time scale free by one multiplicative constant.
what_IS_determined.why_this_matters_for_the_target: The target's channel is tau = ell/v + tau_syn. A forward model can therefore be given a MEASURED delay HETEROGENEITY (a real, heavy-tailed distribution of ell across 166,691 neurons) with only one free scalar v, instead of an author-chosen delay distribution. That is a reduction of author freedom from a whole distribution to one scalar.
what_IS_determined.caveat: The common-v assumption is falsified in advance by the GF data itself: v changed 80% within one animal within 24 h at CONSTANT diameter. v is therefore not even a per-caliber constant; it is a per-cell-type, per-age variable. tau_i/tau_j = ell_i/ell_j must be pre-registered as an assumption, never stated as a measurement.

3_alignment_with_functional_data.verdict: Cell-TYPE level linkage is possible in Drosophila and is a genuine strength of this species. Cell-IDENTITY and contact-IDENTITY linkage to the connectome specimen is IMPOSSIBLE. No learning-longitudinal Drosophila dataset meeting the target's trial requirement was located in this pass.
3_alignment_with_functional_data.why_type_level_linkage_is_real: Most Drosophila CNS neurons are uniquely identifiable single cells or small stereotyped groups per hemisphere (11,691 named types). A neuron recorded in a different fly can be assigned to a connectome type by driver line, morphology and neuropil. This is a level of cross-animal identity mammalian data does not offer. It is TYPE identity, not the same cell, and never the same synapse.

learning_longitudinal.status: NOT FOUND IN THIS METADATA PASS (this is 'not located', NOT 'does not exist')
learning_longitudinal.closest_known_paradigm: Drosophila mushroom body MBON physiology before/after odor-shock or odor-dopamine pairing. These do register the SAME identified cell across pairing, which is exactly the design the target needs.
learning_longitudinal.trial_scale_problem: Such protocols are structurally low-trial: an aversive conditioning session delivers on the order of a few to a dozen odor presentations per phase per cell, with n on the order of 5-20 cells. The ledger's own power analysis for the metric endpoint requires ~1000 trials/phase (paper/진전_원장.md §2). The gap is roughly two orders of magnitude, i.e. WORSE than the mouse Ottenheimer 2023 data already in the repository (60 trials/phase).
learning_longitudinal.trial_counts_status: UNVERIFIED - no specific paper's per-phase trial count was confirmed in this pass. Do not quote a number.

eligibility_four_check_for_a_metric_endp.rule_source: role contract: (i) longitudinal registration of the same cell/contact across learning or intervention; (ii) trials per phase; (iii) an output DISTINCT from the one defining the metric plus a separate behavioral endpoint; (iv) synchronous clock and animal-level holdout
eligibility_four_check_for_a_metric_endp.1_longitudinal_same_cell_or_contact: NO. EM is terminal; the specimen is a single fixed male fly. There is no 'after'.
eligibility_four_check_for_a_metric_endp.2_trials_per_phase: NOT APPLICABLE. Zero trials. The connectome has no time axis at all.
eligibility_four_check_for_a_metric_endp.3_separate_output_and_behavioral_endpoin: NO. No output, no behavior, no likelihood.
eligibility_four_check_for_a_metric_endp.4_synchronous_clock_and_animal_level_hol: NO. n = 1 animal; no clock. Animal-level holdout undefined at n = 1.
eligibility_four_check_for_a_metric_endp.conclusion: MaleCNS is NOT a metric endpoint under any reading. It is a structural prior. Any item requiring these four is left UNIDENTIFIED.

5_explicit_limits.L1_single_specimen_static: MaleCNS v1.0 is ONE male fly imaged by terminal electron microscopy. There is no before and no after. It cannot supply Delta-W-bar or Delta-tau across learning, in principle, not merely in practice. The target's clause (2) asks for a CHANGE; this dataset supplies a single frozen value, and even that from an animal that never performed the task in question.
5_explicit_limits.L2_cross_species_non_summable: The repository's only learning-longitudinal same-cell dataset is Ottenheimer 2023 (adult mouse prelimbic cortex, 8 mice, A1 early/late 60 trials each). Drosophila melanogaster and Mus musculus are different species. Per ladder §1.1 and §1.2, a Drosophila structural component and a mouse functional component MUST NOT be added into one Delta-Theta -> Delta-g -> Delta-Y chain. Doing so is exactly the forbidden move of summing components from different preparations.
5_explicit_limits.L3_efficacy_proxy_is_anatomical: Edge weight = synapse count gated by an ML detection threshold (minconf 0.5). Not conductance, not release probability, not quantal amplitude. Efficacy in the target's sense is a physiological quantity this dataset does not measure.
5_explicit_limits.L4_sign_is_predicted: Neurotransmitter identity is an ML prediction; and in Drosophila glutamate can be inhibitory (GluCl-alpha), so transmitter identity does not fix sign.
5_explicit_limits.L5_delay_scale_is_free: tau requires v. Only the giant fiber (7 um, the animal's largest axon) has a measured v (Kadas et al. 2019). Applying ~2 m/s to sub-micron neurites is an unlicensed scope transport. Absolute tau from this connectome is UNVERIFIED.
5_explicit_limits.L6_geometry_untouched: The connectome says nothing about the Riemannian metric g. In the target, g is an OUTPUT-relative Fisher metric over a population chart. The connectome has no output, no likelihood, no chart, no trials. Clause (1) of the target receives ZERO evidence from this dataset.
5_explicit_limits.L7_P3_is_not_resolved: spec.md P3 failed in F-03 because the STATISTIC was insensitive to the efficacy and delay channels, not because the parameter values were unrealistic. Substituting measured W-bar and measured ell into the same forward model does not by itself make the statistic move. A connectome-parameterized forward model is a better forward model; it is not a P3 certificate. Whether realistic heterogeneity (heavy-tailed ell, heavy-tailed edge weights) restores delay-channel sensitivity is a HYPOTHESIS with a cheap test, not a fact.
5_explicit_limits.L8_ladder_grade: As an anatomical observation with declared species/sex/preparation/unit/endpoint (D. melanogaster, adult male, whole CNS, EM 8 nm, endpoint = synapse count per directed cell pair), this dataset qualifies as BIO_EVIDENCE_L1 for the STRUCTURAL COMPONENT ALONE. Its contribution to the integrated chain Delta-Theta -> Delta-g -> Delta-Y remains BIO_EVIDENCE_L0 / BIOLOGICAL_MEDIATION_UNTESTED because the required longitudinal and interventional arrows are absent. Component L1 does not raise the integrated grade (ladder §4).

6_the_one_genuinely_new_affordance.claim: The strongest thing this release adds to the target is NOT the male data alone, but the now-existing set of MULTIPLE independent whole-CNS / whole-brain connectomes of the same species, which for the first time permits an empirical BETWEEN-INDIVIDUAL variance floor on W-bar at cell-type resolution.
6_the_one_genuinely_new_affordance.why_it_matters: Every refuted card in this lineage assumed a Delta-W-bar or Delta-tau signal without ever establishing the NULL SCALE against which such a change would have to be detected. With two or more independent complete connectomes of the same species, type-to-type synapse count and type-to-type path length can be compared ACROSS INDIVIDUALS, yielding a measured between-animal SD for W-bar and ell. If a learning-induced Delta-W-bar is smaller than the between-animal SD of W-bar, no anatomical experiment can ever detect it - a fact the target needs before designing any further card.
6_the_one_genuinely_new_affordance.status: PROPOSAL, not a result. The comparison has not been run here.
6_the_one_genuinely_new_affordance.caveat: Comparing a male CNS to a female CNS confounds individual variance with sexual dimorphism, and the primary paper's whole point is that 114 types are dimorphic, 262 male-specific and 69 female-specific. A clean same-sex, same-pipeline pair is needed; MANC (male VNC) versus the VNC portion of MCNS may be the only such pair, and even those share a pipeline lineage but not a specimen. Reconstruction pipeline and synapse-detection-threshold differences are confounded with true biological variance and must be handled before any number is quoted.

detail: W-bar (relative, per directed edge): YES, replaced by a measured anatomical count. Removes author freedom over the entire weight distribution and the entire graph topology.
ell (relative path length): YES, derivable from 8 nm SWC skeletons. Removes author freedom over the delay HETEROGENEITY.

v (absolute delay scale): NO. One free scalar remains and it is UNVERIFIED outside the giant fiber. Kadas et al. 2019 further shows v is not a fixed function of caliber (80% change at constant 7 um diameter within 24 h).
tau_syn: NO. Not measured; the literature's 1.8 ms is a uniform assumption carrying zero per-edge information.
sign: NO. Predicted, not measured, and ambiguous for glutamate.
NET: author freedom drops from {topology, weight distribution, delay distribution, v, tau_syn, sign, A} to {v, tau_syn, sign, A}. Real and substantial reduction. NOT a resolution of P3.

b_can_it_enter_the_statistic_as_per_neur.answer: NO for the target's endpoint. CONDITIONAL YES only inside a Drosophila-only question.
detail: For the target's endpoint the answer is NO on two independent grounds, either alone fatal: (i) the connectome is a different SPECIES from the only learning-longitudinal dataset the repository holds (mouse PL, Ottenheimer 2023), and the ladder forbids summing components across preparations; (ii) even within Drosophila the connectome is a different INDIVIDUAL from any recording, so it can supply only a type-level baseline covariate, never a per-cell Delta.

Conditional YES: within a Drosophila functional dataset whose recorded units are assigned to connectome cell types, the connectome supplies legitimate per-TYPE structural covariates - in-degree, out-degree, summed synapse count, path length from a defined input, neuropil membership. These are measured covariates and can enter a statistic. They are static baseline covariates, not Delta-Theta.
The four-part metric-endpoint eligibility check scores 0 of 4 (section 3). That item is left UNIDENTIFIED.

c_worth_opening_as_a_separate_question.answer: YES, but as a different question than the target's fold claim, and with a specific shape.
c_worth_opening_as_a_separate_question.proposed_shape: Provisional Q-CONN-01 (naming for prover/judge): 'Does connectome-measured path length ell predict measured response latency, and does connectome-measured edge synapse count predict measured response gain, across identified Drosophila cell types?' Three properties the three refuted cards lacked: (i) it needs NO learning and NO Delta, so the ~1000 trial/phase wall does not apply; (ii) it puts ell and W-bar directly into the observed statistic as measured covariates rather than as hidden generative parameters - which is precisely the diagnosed cause of death of F-01/F-02/F-03; (iii) if it succeeds it CALIBRATES v, converting the currently UNVERIFIED absolute delay scale into a measured one.
c_worth_opening_as_a_separate_question.second_candidate: The between-individual variance floor of section 6. Cheaper, purely structural, and it tells the target in advance whether any anatomical Delta-W-bar is detectable at all.
c_worth_opening_as_a_separate_question.what_it_is_NOT: Neither candidate tests the target's clause (1) (Riemannian metric) nor clause (2)'s Delta (folding). Neither should be recorded as progress on the fold claim. They are prerequisites that would make a future fold card falsifiable.

7_verdict.one_line: MaleCNS v1.0 is a legitimate, CC-BY, cell-type-resolved structural prior that measures W-bar and relative ell and removes most author freedom from a forward model, but it is a single fixed male fly with zero trials and no output, so it scores 0/4 on metric-endpoint eligibility, cannot supply Delta-W-bar or Delta-tau, cannot be summed with the repository's mouse data, and does not by itself repair the P3 channel-identification failure.

8_do_not_do: Do not download connectome-weights (1.1 GB), body-stats (780 MB), syn-partners (6.8 GB), tbar-nt (2.7 GB), syn-points (12.7 GB) or any EM/N5 volume without explicit user approval. None is needed for a feasibility decision.
Do not quote ~2 m/s as 'the Drosophila conduction velocity'. It is the giant fiber's: 7 um caliber, 24 h post-eclosion, in vivo, 24 C.
Do not treat a synapse count as a conductance.
Do not combine this dataset with Ottenheimer 2023 or any mammalian dataset in one chain.
Do not report the '0.446 ms -> 0.045 ms' delay-matrix figure; its attribution failed.
Do not record 'the connectome parameterizes the forward model' as satisfying spec.md P3. P3 is a property of the statistic, not of the parameter values.
9_parking: Drosophila v (conduction velocity) for sub-micron central neurites has no located primary measurement; a dedicated literature pass (larval motor axons, Kenyon cells, dual-patch latency) is a separate small task.
MANC (male VNC) versus the VNC portion of MCNS may be the only same-sex pair usable for a pipeline-controlled between-individual W-bar variance floor.

DANDI 000289 (EPG two-photon, 761.2 GB) is the only located Drosophila dataset combining a connectome-defined cell type with many trials; its per-phase trial count is unread and would need a metadata-only pass.
The 125M synapse figure is press-page only; confirm against Cell 10.1016/j.cell.2026.08.015 before any paper use.
